captions.caption: A man in a forest is crouching and preparing to lift a large rock.
The man lifts the heavy rock from the ground with both hands.
He carefully places the rock on the ground near a small fire.
He stands up briefly after positioning the first rock.
The man reaches down to pick up another large rock from the mossy floor.
He lifts the second large rock and prepares to stack it.
He positions the rock to place it on top of the first one.
He sets the rock down onto the pile to build a structure.
He adjusts the stack of rocks to ensure they are stable.
He continues to firm up the rock pile by pushing on the stones.
He picks up a smaller rock to fill a gap in the structure.
He places the smaller rock onto the side of the rock pile.
He picks up a much larger, flat rock from the ground.
He lifts the heavy flat rock and carefully places it on the stack.
He finishes placing the large rock and stands back to look at it.
The man turns away from the rock pile he has just constructed.
He walks away from the fire and the rock pile into the woods.
He continues walking away, disappearing into the background forest.
The scene shows the rock pile with smoke rising from the fire nearby.
The man returns to the scene, walking back towards his shelter.
He approaches a large rock near the base of his wooden shelter.
He bends down to pick up a large rock near the shelter's entrance.
He lifts the heavy rock with effort from the mossy ground.
He carries the rock a short distance over to the building area.
He sets the rock down on the ground among other stones.
He stands up and looks around for another suitable rock.
He bends down again to grab another large stone from the forest floor.
He lifts the stone and prepares to move it to the hearth.
He places the stone carefully next to the ones he already moved.
He adjusts the stone's position on the ground for stability.
He reaches for another rock that is partially buried in the moss.
He pulls the rock out of the ground with both hands.
He lifts the rock and carries it towards his rock construction.
He places the rock down to build up the base of a structure.
He reaches for yet another rock located nearby in the forest.
He lifts a smaller rock and prepares to fit it into the wall.
He continues to arrange the rocks in a specific pattern.
He picks up another rock to continue building the structure.
He places the rock and presses down on it to secure its position.
He stands up to survey the progress of his rock wall.
He walks back towards the shelter to find more building materials.
He reaches for a large rock at the base of a nearby tree.
He lifts the large rock from the ground with significant effort.
He starts carrying the rock back towards the fireplace area.
A wide shot shows the man working on his primitive forest shelter.
He is seen from a distance moving around the side of the shelter.
He continues working on the exterior of the wooden lean-to structure.
The man walks around to the front of the shelter entrance.
He bends down to pick up a small item near the opening.
He stands back up and walks towards the side of the shelter.
He reaches for some logs or sticks leaning against the structure.
He carries a piece of wood towards the front area of his camp.
He places the piece of wood down near the fire pit.
He walks back to the side of the shelter to gather more materials.
He picks up another item from the ground near the structure.
He bends down to adjust the foundation materials of the shelter.
The man is seen working intently on the ground level of his camp.
He continues to move and place construction materials for the shelter.
He moves a heavy object near the base of the wooden structure.
He stands up and looks at the overall progress of his forest camp.
